item.title: 1 in 5 U.S. workers admit to calling in sick after Super Bowl, new data finds
item.description: Nearly one in five U.S. workers plan to call in sick the Monday after Super Bowl Sunday, with Gen Z and Millennials being the most likely to do so, and men more likely than women to take sick leave.

item.title: Catherine O'Hara, star of 'Home Alone' and 'Schitt's Creek,' dies at 71
item.description: Renowned actress Catherine O'Hara has died at the age of 71, according to multiple reports.

item.title: Kura Sushi USA unveils monthlong Hello Kitty collaboration
item.description: Kura Sushi USA is launching a monthlong collaboration with Sanrio's Hello Kitty and Friends, featuring exclusive collectible prizes, themed menu items and branded merchandise, from February 1 to February 28.

item.title: Discover Puerto Rico Launches Championship‑Weekend Livestream — and a Chance to Win a Trip
item.description: Discover Puerto Rico is hosting a series of cultural activations during football's championship weekend, featuring a live bilingual watch party called "The Plena Game Report" hosted by Isiah Pacheco and featuring performances by Plena Libre.

item.title: Pepsi offers $100K in cash prizes during Super Bowl broadcast
item.description: During the Big Game, fans can enter the PEPSI® Taste Wins Super Bowl Instant Win Game by posting on X using @Pepsi, #PepsiTasteWins, and #PepsiEntry to win cash prizes up to $25,000.

item.title: Free queso and chips at Qdoba during every full moon in 2026
item.description: QDOBA is offering free queso and chips to rewards members during every monthly full moon in 2026 with the purchase of a full-size entrée.

item.title: Sonic Drive-In celebrates National Tater Tot Day with free tots
item.description: SONIC Drive-In is offering a free medium order of its signature tots on Monday, Feb. 2, in celebration of National Tater Tot Day, with any purchase made through the SONIC App.

item.title: Museum celebrates Bessie Coleman's impact on aviation history
item.description: The Frontiers of Flight Museum in Dallas is hosting an interactive exhibit celebrating the legacy of Bessie Coleman, the first Black person and first American woman to earn a pilot's license.

item.title: CeeDee Lamb gifts Air Force vet a Super Bowl experience
item.description: CeeDee Lamb, wide receiver for the Dallas Cowboys, is gifting a surprise trip to San Francisco for Super Bowl LX to a decorated Air Force veteran from New Mexico, Tech. Sgt. Chris Ferrell, and his wife, Lauren.

item.title: Watch the Super Bowl at Fort Worth's Rooftop Cinema Club
item.description: Rooftop Cinema Club Fort Worth will host a Super Bowl Sunday viewing event featuring a 24-foot LED screen, the game, commercials, and a halftime show, with the Fort Worth skyline as a backdrop.
